versions.changelog: 新增联合分析包装器(run_combined_analysis.py)和单体配方投料表自动生成(gen_monomer_formulation_table.py)。投料规则更新：单体浓度1.0M，终体积1.5mL，DMSO动态补全，引发剂3.75mg，无交联剂。
修正依赖声明：区分Python包依赖(pandas,biopython)和系统依赖(clustalo)
更新SKILL.md：完善氨基酸分类体系、计数方法、φ值计算公式的详细描述
通用化description表述，强调适用任何蛋白质家族；移除PDF批量分析脚本引用（特定使用场景）
统一氨基酸分类体系：A/G/P 排除不统计（与 serine-protease-fragment-analysis 对齐）；method.md 补充最终验证方法细节

- Initial release of aa-pair-analysis for protein amino acid functional pair frequency analysis.
- Supports batch analysis from PDF consensus sequences or full pipeline from FASTA input (MSA, consensus extraction, pair count, formulation calculation).
- Provides ready-to-use scripts for complete analysis workflow and batch processing.
- Outputs include Top5 high-frequency pair types, phi values, and summary statistics for each clade.
- Includes environment setup instructions and clear parameter/configuration guidance.
- Amino acid functional classification and counting method are fixed and documented for reproducibility.
